verdict.rationale: Cursor's background/agent architecture (docs-8,9,11,12) lets agents run asynchronously and be monitored via terminal, Slack, or GitHub (docs-10), implying a task started in one context can be checked or continued from another surface, though there's no explicit cross-device 'resume in browser' feature documented. Community evidence (comm-1) confirms Cursor explicitly denies any single-device restriction, but this is via a bot hallucination controversy rather than a positive feature statement.
